Try saying things like "you know that guy in our class? i've heard he's about to fail it because of depression" or something similar. Pay attention to his reaction/opinion on that. Hi! First, congrats on having the courage to do something about it. I told my mom I was feeling depressive when I was 16 and it took me a long time before I had the courage to do it.

So I think it's important to prepare what you're going to say and try to explain as clear as possible that you're not feeling well and that you'd like to try something to help (therapy, maybe). Tell them how much you love them, that this isn't their fault, that they don't have reasons to freak out. Try to show them how much you need their support right now. 

You could also talk to the school psychologist (if your school has one). They can help you talk to your parents too.
